// Return Validated Result: flattened production-shaped output.
// Only reached if Validate LOOM Score did NOT throw, so this is always
// a passing result -- no validation_errors key needed here.
const v = $json;
const p = v.parsed;

return [{ json: {
  schema_version: p.schema_version,
  run_id: p.run_id,
  tenant_id: p.tenant_id,
  clip_id: p.clip_id,
  hook_score: p.hook_score,
  completeness_score: p.completeness_score,
  clarity_score: p.clarity_score,
  emotional_intensity_score: p.emotional_intensity_score,
  shareability_score: p.shareability_score,
  context_dependency_score: p.context_dependency_score,
  duration_score: p.duration_score,
  duration_fit: p.duration_fit,
  openshorts_score: v.openshorts_score,
  overall_score: v.overall_score,
  dead_air_detected: p.dead_air_detected,
  repair_actions: p.repair_actions,
  hard_failure_codes: p.hard_failure_codes,
  suggested_hook: p.suggested_hook,
  suggested_caption: p.suggested_caption,
  confidence: p.confidence,
  evidence_summary: p.evidence_summary,
  unverified_dimensions: v.authoritative_unverified_dimensions,
  model_unverified_dimensions: v.model_unverified_dimensions,
  decision: v.decision,
  model_recommended_decision: v.model_recommended_decision,
  decision_agreement: v.decision_agreement,
  verification_status: 'semantic_only_pending_closed_weight_clip_verifier'
} }];
